en.title: Tainan City Implements Visual Impairment Support; Accessible Transport Donations Boost Mobility
en.summary: Tainan City Education Bureau has implemented reasonable adjustments and provided assistive devices to support visually impaired students in regular classrooms. Meanwhile, Good Food Restaurant donated an accessible midibus benefiting 300 disabled individuals, and similar donations of accessible buses continue to improve transportation access. Advocacy groups also clarified that disability pensions do not prohibit employment, encouraging inclusive workforce participation.

zh-TW.title: 南市 教局 落實 視障 輔助 良品 捐贈 無障礙 中巴 惠及 300 身障者
zh-TW.summary: 南市教局已落實合理調整，提供視障學生所需輔具，使課堂學習無障礙。同時，良品餐飲捐贈無障礙中巴，惠及300位身障者提升行動便利。日本的殘障就業支援服務也受到批判，指出其以營利為主，未真正考慮殘障者需求。
